lines.name: Line 1
lines.nameLocal: Tuyến số 1 (Bến Thành – Suối Tiên)
lines.description: First HCMC metro line, Bến Thành – Suối Tiên (19.7 km, 14 stations, 3 underground), in commercial service since 22 Dec 2024. Planned western extension Bến Thành – An Hạ (Line 1 reaches 40.8 km in Decision 1711; the Oct 2026 draft plan would re-label it part of a new east–west Line 8). Eastern extension Suối Tiên – Đồng Nai administrative centre – Long Thành airport (~44 km, Đồng Nai investment policy approved Apr 2026, PPP, 2026-2030; intermediate stations not published, shown as indicative waypoints). Colour as used on OSM and Wikipedia.

segments.label: Bến Thành – Suối Tiên (opened 22 Dec 2024)
Western extension Bến Thành – An Hạ (Decision 1711; priority list for 2035; waypoints follow the published road alignment)
Extension Suối Tiên – Đồng Nai admin centre – Long Thành airport (~44 km, Đồng Nai PPP project, 2026-2030; intermediate points indicative)

lines.name: Line 2
lines.nameLocal: Tuyến số 2 (Thủ Thiêm – Bến Thành – Tham Lương)
lines.description: Bến Thành – Tham Lương (11.3 km, 11 stations, mostly underground) broke ground 15 Jan 2026; Bến Thành – Thủ Thiêm (6.2 km) broke ground 29 Apr 2026; both targeted for commercial operation by end-2030. The western section Tham Lương – An Hạ and branch 2S An Hạ – Tây Bắc Củ Chi urban area are on the 2026-2030 priority list (PPP proposal by Him Lam – Việt Thiên Hà – VRCC, alignment not yet published). Full line in Decision 1711: 62.2 km. Colour as used on OSM and Wikipedia.

segments.label: Bến Thành – Thủ Thiêm (construction began 29 Apr 2026)
Bến Thành – Tham Lương (construction began 15 Jan 2026)
Tham Lương – An Hạ (2026-2030 priority list; PPP proposal, alignment indicative)
Branch 2S An Hạ – Tây Bắc Củ Chi urban area (2026-2030 priority list; alignment indicative)
Eastern extension Thủ Thiêm – Sông Tắc bus terminal (network plan; no schedule)

lines.name: Line 3
lines.nameLocal: Tuyến số 3 (An Hạ – Tao Đàn)
lines.description: An Hạ – Lê Minh Xuân – Tân Kiên – QL1 – Kinh Dương Vương – Hồng Bàng – Hùng Vương – Ngã 6 Cộng Hòa – Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai – Tao Đàn. Formerly Hiệp Bình Phước – An Hạ (45.8 km); its northern part is now covered by the Thủ Dầu Một – Tao Đàn line. On the priority list for completion by 2035; investor proposals under study (Oct 2026). The Oct 2026 draft plan would extend it west to Tây Ninh. Stations are waypoints along the published alignment.

segments.label: An Hạ – Tao Đàn (target 2035)

lines.name: Line 4
lines.nameLocal: Tuyến số 4 (Đông Thạnh – Hiệp Phước)
lines.description: Đông Thạnh – Hà Huy Giáp – Nguyễn Oanh – Nguyễn Kiệm – Tân Sơn Nhất airport – Nguyễn Văn Trỗi – Hai Bà Trưng – Bến Thành – Nguyễn Hữu Thọ – Bà Chiêm bridge – Hiệp Phước (47.3 km). Priority line for 2035; Sovico has studied a ~43 km version via the airport. Southern stations (ST.13–ST.30) follow OSM mapping of that study; northern points are waypoints. The Oct 2026 draft plan would extend it north to Thủ Dầu Một.

segments.label: Đông Thạnh – Hiệp Phước (target 2035)
Northern extension to Thủ Dầu Một (Oct 2026 draft network plan, not approved)

lines.name: Line 5
lines.nameLocal: Tuyến số 5 (Hưng Long – Vinhomes Grand Park / Sông Tắc)
lines.description: Hưng Long university town – new Cần Giuộc bus station – QL50 – Cao Xuân Dục – Phù Đổng Thiên Vương – Lý Thường Kiệt – Hoàng Văn Thụ – Phan Đăng Lưu – Bạch Đằng – Điện Biên Phủ – Võ Nguyên Giáp – Liên Phường – Long Thuận, then branches to Vinhomes Grand Park and Sông Tắc (53.9 km, Decision 1711). Proposed for deferral to 2036-2045 (Sep 2025 priority review). An Aug 2025 description gives a different alignment (Long Trường – Sài Gòn bridge – Bảy Hiền – Đa Phước), and the Oct 2026 draft keeps only the Hoàng Văn Thụ – Tân Cảng branch; treat the alignment as uncertain.

segments.label: Hưng Long – Vinhomes Grand Park (target 2036-2045)
Branch to Sông Tắc bus terminal

lines.name: Line 6 (Inner Ring)
lines.nameLocal: Tuyến số 6 (vành đai trong)
lines.description: Inner ring line (53.8 km). Phase 1 Bà Quẹo – Tân Sơn Nhất airport – Gò Vấp – Bình Triệu – Phú Hữu (~23 km, 17 stations ST01–ST17) is one of the 8 lines targeted for 2030; investment preparation under way, construction start planned for end-2026; interchange with the Thủ Thiêm – Long Thành line at Phú Hữu. Phase 2 closes the ring via Võ Chí Công – Tân Thuận – Nguyễn Thị Thập – Tạ Quang Bửu – Nguyễn Văn Luông – Phú Lâm – Lũy Bán Bích – Âu Cơ (priority list for 2035; waypoints only).

segments.label: Phase 1 Tân Sơn Nhất (Bà Quẹo) – Phú Hữu (~23 km, target 2030)
Phase 2 Phú Hữu – Tân Thuận – Phú Lâm – Bà Quẹo (target 2035)

lines.name: Line 7
lines.nameLocal: Tuyến số 7 (Tân Kiên – Long Bình)
lines.description: Tân Kiên – Nguyễn Văn Linh – Bình Hưng Nam – Đào Sư Tích – Phú Mỹ Hưng – Huỳnh Tấn Phát – Trần Bạch Đằng – Trần Não – Thảo Điền – Thanh Đa – Trường Thọ – Rạch Chiếc – High Tech Park (D2) – Vinhomes Grand Park – Long Bình depot (51.2 km). Proposed for deferral to 2036-2045. The Oct 2026 draft plan would extend it north to Biên Hòa and south-west to Tây Ninh.

lines.name: Ben Thanh – Can Gio Railway
lines.nameLocal: Tuyến số 12 / Đường sắt Bến Thành – Cần Giờ
lines.description: High-speed (up to 350 km/h) line from 23/9 Park (Bến Thành) along Hoàng Diệu – Nguyễn Văn Linh – Nhà Bè – Bình Khánh to the Cần Giờ coastal reclaimed urban area (54 km). PPP by VinSpeed (Vingroup), ~102,430 bn VND; groundbreaking 19 Dec 2025; operation targeted for 2028. Phase 1 has only 2 stations (Bến Thành, Cần Giờ); 4 intermediate stations may be added later. The Oct 2026 draft envisions a long-term bridge/tunnel link on to Vũng Tàu.

notes: Network as of November 2026. Only Line 1 (Bến Thành – Suối Tiên, opened 22 Dec 2024) is in service. Under construction: Line 2 Bến Thành – Tham Lương (since 15 Jan 2026) and Bến Thành – Thủ Thiêm (since 29 Apr 2026), both targeted for 2030, and the Bến Thành – Cần Giờ railway (groundbreaking 19 Dec 2025, target 2028). Status "approved" is used for lines on the Resolution 188/2025/QH15 project list or with an approved investment policy whose preparation is funded (Thủ Thiêm – Long Thành, Bình Dương Line 1, Thủ Dầu Một – Tao Đàn, Line 6 phase 1, Line 1 extension to Long Thành airport); several still await formal feasibility approval, with construction starts announced for end-2026. Planned lines follow the approved network: Decision 1711/QĐ-TTg (31 Dec 2024) for the former HCMC (Lines 1-12), plus the former Bình Dương (12 lines, ~305 km) and Bà Rịa – Vũng Tàu (3 lines, ~125 km) provincial plans, about 27 lines and ~1,012 km after the 1 July 2025 merger. Target years come from the city programme: ~255 km in 8 lines by 2030, ~532 km by 2035 (the 7-line, 355 km project of Dec 2024 was later enlarged), Lines 5 and 7 deferred to 2036-2045, and Lines 8-10 (155 km) by 2045. Lines without a year have no published schedule. A draft 100-year network plan (consultant ARUP, reported Oct 2026) proposes ~1,540-1,555 km (about 1,100 km metro and 440-460 km LRT by 2050 and beyond) and renumbers several lines; it is not approved, so only a few of its extensions are shown, as "proposed". Station positions: operating and under-construction stations come from OpenStreetMap. Stations of approved lines come from OSM volunteer mapping of published alignment drawings and may shift. For lines without a published station list, the points are waypoints named after the roads or places in the plan text (marked approximate), not official stations. Long-distance lines show straight segments between these waypoints. Line colours: Line 1 and 2 and the numbered lines use the colours of OSM / Wikipedia; there is no published official palette for future lines. Other colours were chosen for this app. National and inter-regional railways (North–South high-speed rail, HCMC – Cần Thơ, Biên Hòa – Vũng Tàu, HCMC – Tây Ninh / Lộc Ninh) are out of scope.
